name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Pyrotechnic Dominance
archetype: Special Fire/Psychic starter sweeper, sleep-immune Fighting/Ground breaker, and Intimidate aerial pivot.
gym_duel_rationale: Erika enforces a strict 3v3 duel. Lead with Charizard/Kadabra (457 BST Fire/Psychic with 112 SpA, 103 Spe, and STAB Flamethrower/Psychic hitting Erika's Grass/Poison rosters). Back with Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST breaker whose Vital Spirit ignores Sleep Powder/Hypnosis) and Gyarados/Fearow (495 BST intimidator with 4x Ice Fang against Grass/Flying threats).

roster.progression_notes: Charizard splices with Kadabra. 457 BST with 112 SpA and 103 Speed. Obliterates Erika's grass and poison roster with STAB Flamethrower/Psychic plus Recover sustain.
457 BST physical fortress with 101 Attack and 93 Defense. Vital Spirit completely immunizes against sleep powders while STAB Cross Chop and Magnitude break heavy targets.
495 BST with 101 Attack and 93 Speed. Intimidate cripples enemy physical attackers upon entry, while Ice Fang and Drill Peck deal massive super-effective damage.
422 BST with 96 Attack and 93 Speed. Arena Trap prevents escapes, while natural 100 BP Earthquake (Lv. 35) and Ice Fang provide wide coverage.

roster.status: Active in Party (Celadon Gift & Route 7 Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Gift Eevee evolved with Thunder Stone (Dept Store 4F) and spliced with Route 7 Houndour. 425 BST with 100 SpA and Volt Absorb electric immunity.

flex_bench.why_use: Retained for wild catches with Compound Eyes 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder.
Magic Guard completely prevents indirect damage, entry hazard chips, and poison ticks.

active_fusions: Charizard/Kadabra (457 BST Fire/Psychic with 112 SpA, 103 Spe, and Recover)
Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST Vital Spirit sleep-immune physical breaker)
Gyarados/Fearow (495 BST Water/Flying intimidator with Ice Fang and Drill Peck)
Dugtrio/Arbok (422 BST Ground/Poison trapper with Earthquake and Sucker Punch)

unfuse_recommendations: 1. Celadon Poké Mart: Pay $300 to unfuse Charmeleon/Dugtrio from Chapter 3.
2. Level Charmeleon to Lv. 36 to evolve into Charizard.
3. Splice Charizard with Kadabra using Super Splicer for 112 SpA Fire/Psychic STAB and Recover.
4. Splice Dugtrio with Arbok, and evolve gift Eevee into Jolteon before splicing with Houndour.
upcoming_fusions: Charizard/Alakazam (Endgame Fire/Psychic titan with Linking Cord)
